property_summary: For any caller, amounts, and lock time, a completed Collect call on the reference contract either reverts (if guards fail) or, if it returns normally, the caller's recorded Acc.balance decreases by at most the requested amount; the reentrancy-broken mutant can reenter and withdraw more than _am in one Collect call causing Acc balances to drop by more than _am.
change_summary: Remove the require check in the nonReentrant_ modifier (replace it with a no-op) so reentrancy guard is disabled, enabling reentrant changes to Acc during Collect.
